# Agent Instructions

All coding agents working in this repository must follow the rules in [copilot-instructions.md](copilot-instructions.md).

## Required Behavior

1. Read [copilot-instructions.md](copilot-instructions.md) before taking action.
2. Select and follow the correct workflow skill from [skills](skills) for each request.
3. Treat skill workflows as mandatory process, not optional guidance.
4. Keep changes minimal, verify with tests/checks, and avoid unrelated edits.

## Skill Entry Point

Start with [using-agent-skills](skills/using-agent-skills/SKILL.md), then follow the mapped workflow for the task type.
